scripts.dev:android:studio: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (-not $env:CAP_TARGET) { throw 'Set CAP_TARGET first (e.g. $env:CAP_TARGET="emulator-5554")' }; $repo=(Get-Location).Path; if (-not $env:VITE_CAP_SERVER_URL) { $env:VITE_CAP_SERVER_URL='http://10.0.2.2:3000' }; $job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Set-Location $using:repo; npm run dev:android }; try { Set-Location $repo; npx cap run android -l --port 3000 --target $env:CAP_TARGET } finally { try { Stop-Job $job -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; try { Remove-Job $job -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }"
scripts.dev:android:studio:both: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if (-not $env:CAP_TARGET_EMU) { throw 'Set CAP_TARGET_EMU first (e.g. $env:CAP_TARGET_EMU="emulator-5554")' }; if (-not $env:CAP_TARGET_DEVICE) { throw 'Set CAP_TARGET_DEVICE first (adb id)' }; $repo=(Get-Location).Path; $lanIp = $env:CAP_LAN_IP; if (-not $lanIp) { try { $lanIp = (Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^127\.' -and $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^169\.254\.' -and $_.PrefixOrigin -ne 'WellKnown' } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty IPAddress) } catch { $lanIp = $null } }; if (-not $lanIp) { throw 'Set CAP_LAN_IP (e.g. $env:CAP_LAN_IP="192.168.1.23")' }; $jobVite = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Set-Location $using:repo; npm run dev:android }; try { $jobEmu = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Set-Location $using:repo; $env:VITE_CAP_SERVER_URL='http://10.0.2.2:3000'; npx cap run android -l --port 3000 --target $env:CAP_TARGET_EMU }; $jobDev = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { Set-Location $using:repo; $env:VITE_CAP_SERVER_URL=('http://' + $using:lanIp + ':3000'); npx cap run android -l --port 3000 --target $env:CAP_TARGET_DEVICE }; Receive-Job -Job $jobEmu -Wait -AutoRemoveJob } finally { try { Stop-Job $jobDev -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; try { Stop-Job $jobVite -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; try { Remove-Job $jobDev -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; try { Remove-Job $jobVite -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }"
scripts.buildj: npm run build && npm run proofshot:verify-ui
scripts.cap:run:android:live:target: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not $env:CAP_TARGET) { throw 'Set CAP_TARGET first (e.g. $env:CAP_TARGET=\"emulator-5554\")' }; $env:VITE_CAP_SERVER_URL='http://10.0.2.2:3000'; npx cap run android -l --port 3000 --target $env:CAP_TARGET"
scripts.proofshot:verify-ui: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:AGENT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH='C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; try { proofshot start --run \"npm run dev\" --port 3000; proofshot exec snapshot -i; proofshot exec screenshot buildj-login.png } finally { proofshot stop; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'proofshot stop skipped (no active session).'; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0 } }"
